# Review pack: review-security-input-injection (csharp)

Language-specific part of the `review-security-input-injection` pack, for targets where `csharp` is detected. Read it together with `packs/review-security-input-injection.md`.

## File: `references/languages/csharp.md`

### Detection signals — C#/.NET (Security: Input & Injection)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). A signal is evidence only when untrusted data reaches it or the setting is explicit (`SKILL.md`
step 3). The only .NET defaults a worker may rely on are those stated in `dotnet-input.md` (NET-07, NET-08, NET-11,
NET-14); for anything else, report explicit values only.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FromSqlRaw`/`ExecuteSqlRaw`/`SqlQueryRaw` with `$"…"` or `+`; `SqlCommand`/`OleDbCommand` text built by concatenation; Dapper `Query(sql + …)` | repositories, `DbContext` code, services | SQL built from untrusted values | NET-01, NET-07, SQL-01 |
| Home-made `Escape(…)` / `Replace("'", "''")` before building SQL | data access helpers | Manual escaping instead of binding | SQL-05 |
| `SqlCommand` without `Parameters.Add…` next to user values; values "validated" then concatenated | data access | No bind API; validation used instead of binding | QP-02, SQL-06 |
| `OrderBy` strings, `$"ORDER BY {sort}"` or table names from request input | repositories, query builders | Dynamic identifiers not allowlisted | SQL-04, NET-02 |
| `EXEC('…' + @p)`, `sp_executesql` with concatenated text | `*.sql` stored procedures, migrations | Dynamic SQL inside procedures | SQL-03 |
| Connection strings with `User Id=sa`, `db_owner`/admin accounts | `appsettings*.json`, `web.config`, migrations | Over-privileged database account | SQL-07 |
| `XmlReaderSettings { DtdProcessing = DtdProcessing.Parse }`; `XmlUrlResolver` or a non-null `XmlResolver` on `XmlDocument`/`XmlReaderSettings`; `XslCompiledTransform` with `XsltSettings.TrustedXslt` | XML parsing code | DTDs/external resources enabled on untrusted XML | NET-08, NET-05, XML-01, XML-02 |
| Schemas loaded from `xsi:schemaLocation` or an `http://` URL | XML validation code | Untrusted schema source | XML-05 |
| `BinaryFormatter`, `SoapFormatter`, `LosFormatter`, `NetDataContractSerializer`, `ObjectStateFormatter` | serializers, caches, message consumers | Dangerous native deserialization | NET-09, DES-03 |
| Newtonsoft `TypeNameHandling` other than `None` (without a `SerializationBinder`); `JavaScriptTypeResolver`; `Type.GetType(<payload value>)` | JSON settings, `Program.cs`, consumers | Payload selects the type | DES-02, DES-09, NET-04 |
| `Process.Start`/`ProcessStartInfo.Arguments` with request data; `cmd.exe /c`, `powershell -Command` with input | services, controllers | Command injection | NET-15, INJ-04, INJ-05 |
| `CSharpScript.EvaluateAsync`, `DataTable.Compute`, dynamic LINQ strings from input | services | Runtime code/expression evaluation | INJ-03 |
| `DirectorySearcher.Filter` / LDAP filters built by concatenation; `XPathNavigator.Select(… + input)` | directory and XML query code | LDAP/XPath injection | INJ-06 |
| `Html.Raw`, `new HtmlString(`, Blazor `MarkupString` / `@((MarkupString)…)` with user data | `*.cshtml`, `*.razor`, tag helpers | Encoding bypassed | NET-03, XSS-02 |
| Inline `<script>` with `@Model…` or `@Json.Serialize(…)` of user data; `innerHTML` with server values | views, front-end scripts | Wrong-context encoding | NET-13, XSS-04, XSS-09 |
| `<%= … %>` in Web Forms/MVC 5 views relying on `ValidateRequest` | `*.aspx`, `*.ascx`, legacy views | Legacy XSS | NET-06 |
| `IFormFile.FileName` in a storage path (`Path.Combine(dir, file.FileName)`) | upload handlers | Client filename used for storage | NET-10, FU-04 |
| Upload type decided by `IFormFile.ContentType` only; extension check on the raw name | upload handlers | Weak type validation | FU-03, FU-02, FU-01 |
| `MaxRequestBodySize = null`, `[DisableRequestSizeLimit]`, very large `[RequestSizeLimit]`/`MultipartBodyLengthLimit`; `ZipArchive` extracted without size/entry limits | `Program.cs`, controllers, upload code | Unbounded upload size | NET-11, FU-05 |
| Uploads saved under `wwwroot` / content root; `UseStaticFiles` serving the upload folder; links to `/uploads/<name>` | `Program.cs`, upload code, views | Uploads served/executed from storage | NET-12, FU-07, FU-08 |
| MVC/Razor Pages handlers without `[ApiController]` and without `ModelState.IsValid`; `SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter = true` | controllers, pages, `Program.cs` | Validation result ignored | NET-14, IV-07 |
| EF entities bound directly as action parameters | controllers | Mass assignment | IV-07 |
| `new Regex(pattern)` on input without `matchTimeout` or `RegexOptions.NonBacktracking` | validators | ReDoS-prone validation | IV-08 |
| `[StringLength]`/`[Range]`/`[MaxLength]` absent on request DTO strings, numbers and collections | DTOs, view models | Unbounded field rules | IV-02 |

## File: `references/standards/dotnet-input.md`

*Load rule: NET-01…15. Load when language `csharp` is detected.*

### .NET / ASP.NET Core / EF Core input & injection guidance — localized summary

- Applies when language `csharp` is detected. EF Core elements (NET-01, NET-02, NET-07) apply when
  `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore*` is referenced; ASP.NET Core elements (NET-03, NET-10 … NET-14) when
  `Microsoft.AspNetCore.*`/`Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web` is used; NET-06 only for legacy ASP.NET (`System.Web`); runtime
  elements (NET-04, NET-05, NET-08, NET-09, NET-15) always.
- Level: a vendor element takes the level of the OWASP element it supports, or `SHOULD` when the vendor only
  recommends. **(Default)** marks an element that states API behaviour or a default; cite the OWASP element it supports
  and name the NET element in the recommendation. Where vendor guidance is weaker than an OWASP element (e.g. EF Core's
  advice to "sanitize" dynamic column names), the OWASP element (SQL-04, SQL-05) decides. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.
- Defaults stated here are the only .NET defaults a worker may rely on. `XmlDocument`/`XmlTextReader` defaults on .NET
  Framework are **not** localized: report only explicit insecure settings there, and add a `localized-standard-gap` note
  for a missing setting.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NET-01 | MUST | Prefer EF LINQ; for SQL text use `FromSql`/`FromSqlInterpolated`; never concatenate untrusted values into SQL passed to `FromSqlRaw` or other command APIs. | `FromSqlRaw($"… {input}")`; `SqlCommand` with concatenated text | SEC-II-02 |
| NET-02 | MUST | Parameters are values, not identifiers: map dynamic table/column names to a fixed allowlist; parameterization doesn't replace a minimal-privilege DB account. | dynamic identifiers from input | SEC-II-03 |
| NET-03 | MUST | Don't bypass Razor encoding with `Html.Raw`/`HtmlString` for untrusted content; HTML encoding isn't safe inside JS, CSS or URLs; user HTML goes through a maintained sanitizer. | `@Html.Raw(Model.UserText)`; `new HtmlString(input)` | SEC-II-08 |
| NET-04 | MUST | Prefer a data-only format (`System.Text.Json`) into application-defined types and validate the values; a different serializer doesn't remove the need to constrain converters and type selection. | polymorphic converters driven by payload type names | SEC-II-09 |
| NET-05 | MUST | XML: disable unnecessary external resource resolution and follow the settings for the parser in use; defaults differ by API and framework version. | `XmlResolver = new XmlUrlResolver()`; `DtdProcessing.Parse` on untrusted input | SEC-II-05 |
| NET-06 | MUST | Legacy ASP.NET: request validation alone doesn't prevent XSS; use context-appropriate output encoding. | `<%= %>` / `@Html.Raw` relying on `ValidateRequest` | SEC-II-08 |
| NET-07 | MUST | (Default) `FromSql`, `FromSqlInterpolated` and `ExecuteSql` wrap interpolated values in `DbParameter`s; `FromSqlRaw`/`ExecuteSqlRaw` insert interpolated values as raw SQL, so values must be passed as `DbParameter`s. Identifiers follow SQL-04. | `ExecuteSqlRaw($"…{v}")`; `FromSqlRaw("…" + v)` | SEC-II-02 |
| NET-08 | MUST | (Default) `XmlReaderSettings.DtdProcessing` defaults to `Prohibit`; `Parse` enables DTDs, so setting it on untrusted input fails XML-01 unless XML-02 holds. | explicit `DtdProcessing = DtdProcessing.Parse` | SEC-II-05 |
| NET-09 | MUST | `BinaryFormatter.Deserialize` is never safe with untrusted input, and a `SerializationBinder` or configuration switch can't mitigate it; `SoapFormatter`, `LosFormatter`, `NetDataContractSerializer` and `ObjectStateFormatter` are equally dangerous. | any of these on external data | SEC-II-09 |
| NET-10 | MUST | Never use the client filename for storage; create one with `Path.GetRandomFileName`/`GetTempFileName`; HTML-encode the original name when displaying outside Razor; check for collisions. | `Path.Combine(dir, file.FileName)` | SEC-II-06 |
| NET-11 | MUST | (Default) Kestrel caps request bodies at 30,000,000 bytes and `FormOptions.MultipartBodyLengthLimit` at 134,217,728 bytes; removing or raising limits without bound fails FU-05/IV-04. | `MaxRequestBodySize = null`; `[DisableRequestSizeLimit]`; very large `[RequestSizeLimit]` on upload actions | SEC-II-06 |
| NET-12 | MUST | Store uploads in a dedicated location outside the app's directory tree with execute permissions disabled. | uploads saved under the content root/`wwwroot` | SEC-II-07 |
| NET-13 | MUST | Encode at the point of output (don't store encoded values); pass data to JS via `data-` attributes read with `textContent`, or use `JavaScriptEncoder`; use `HtmlEncoder`/`UrlEncoder` in code; no `document.write`/DOM string concatenation. | `JsonSerializer.Serialize(model)` inlined into `<script>`; `innerHTML` with server values | SEC-II-08 |
| NET-14 | MUST | (Default) Web apps must check `ModelState.IsValid`; `[ApiController]` returns 400 automatically when model state is invalid. Client-side validation doesn't replace server-side checks. | MVC/Razor Pages handlers without `ModelState.IsValid`; `SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter = true` without manual checks | SEC-II-01 |
| NET-15 | SHOULD | Use `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` (escaped per argument) rather than the `Arguments` string; `ProcessStartInfo` with untrusted data is a security risk. | `Arguments = "… " + input` | SEC-II-04 |
